title: Dalada Maligawa (Temple of Tooth)
subtitle: Kandy City • UNESCO Heritage
description: The sacred heart of Kandy housing the Tooth Relic of Lord Buddha, set beside the scenic Kandy Lake.

title: Gampola Ambuluwawa Tower
subtitle: Gampola • 360° Mountain View
description: Iconic multi-religious spiral tower offering breathtaking 360-degree mountain views high above Gampola.

title: Horton Plains & World's End
subtitle: Nuwara Eliya • Cloud Forest
description: High-altitude plateau with misty cloud forests and the dramatic 4,000 ft vertical drop at World's End precipice.

title: Nuwara Eliya (Little England)
subtitle: Central Highlands • Tea Valleys
description: Lush green tea plantations, cool mountain climate, Gregory Lake, colonial bungalows, and cascading waterfalls.

title: Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress
subtitle: UNESCO World Wonder
description: Ancient 5th-century palace fortress built atop a 200m giant rock, renowned for ancient wall frescoes and water gardens.

title: Dambulla Golden Cave Temple
subtitle: Matale District • Ancient Cave Art
description: Sri Lanka's largest preserved cave temple complex containing 153 statues of Lord Buddha and vibrant ceiling frescoes.

title: Riverston Peak & Pitawala Pathana
subtitle: Knuckles Mountain Range
description: Windy mountain ridges, Mini World's End cliff view, and pristine trekking trails through Knuckles conservation forest.

title: Bahirawakanda Buddha Statue
subtitle: Kandy City • Sunset Viewpoint
description: Towering 88ft giant white Buddha statue overlooking Kandy city, offering spectacular sunset and city lights view.

title: Ella & Nine Arch Bridge
subtitle: Badulla District • Demodara Viaduct
description: World-famous 9-arch colonial brick railway bridge surrounded by lush green tea trees and high mountain peaks.
